continuity: Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao accepts the Emperor’s command and becomes Crown Prince; the Emperor is his older brother and had kept the succession seat empty to protect him.
The Emperor declares that Aehyang and her unborn child have no connection to him, and that the child is the late City Lord of Sichuan Province’s.

The Emperor announces memorials for those who fell in the battle, civilians sacrificed in the struggles among the realm’s heroes, and the Maoshan Sect; they will be established in the Crown Prince’s name.
Jin Taekyung signed the pledge and, with Hong Jin, stops the Grand Academician from escaping after the Emperor’s announcement.
plot: After Jin Taekyung kills Wei Zhong, he tells the Emperor that he spared Wei because he remembered others who regretted their wrong choices. The Emperor announces memorials for those killed in the battle, the people sacrificed in the struggles among the realm’s heroes, and the Maoshan Sect, and declares that they will be established in the Crown Prince’s name.

The Emperor commands Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao to accept the vacant Crown Prince’s seat, revealing that he kept it empty and sent Zhu Bao away to protect him. He also declares that Aehyang and her unborn child are unrelated to him and that the child is the late City Lord of Sichuan Province’s. As the Emperor and Zhu Bao embrace as brothers, Jin Taekyung confronts a conspirator trying to escape; Hong Jin knocks the Grand Academician unconscious.
translation_decisions: Render 대학사 as “Grand Academician,” 위령비 as “memorial,” and 연판장 as “pledge.”

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Prince Shangshan, whose personal name is Zhu Bao, is the Emperor’s thirteen-year-old youngest younger brother, an exceptionally skilled young swordsman, and the heir publicly designated by the Emperor.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Prince Shangshan, whose personal name is Zhu Bao, is the Emperor’s thirteen-year-old younger brother, an exceptionally skilled young swordsman, and the newly appointed Crown Prince.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao is the Emperor’s youngest younger brother, and Hong Jin has been his steadfast caretaker since childhood. Zhu Bao admires Jin Taekyung, calls him a friend, and credits the support of those around him with giving him a different path from the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, whom he met with compassion.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Zhu Bao is the Emperor’s younger brother and Crown Prince, and Hong Jin has been his steadfast caretaker since childhood. He admires Jin Taekyung and calls him a friend; his compassion for the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord reflects the different path made possible by those who supported him.
